description.zh:
返回值语言，取值：
- zh：中文
- en：英文

默认：en
description.en:
The language of the return value. Valid values:

- zh: Chinese

- en: English

Default: en

descriptions.zh:
修改成功后，DNS会被修改为云解析DNS（hichina.com结尾的DNS）。
> **使用前提：适用于阿里云注册域名，且当前DNS服务器是第三方DNS的域名使用。**
descriptions.en:
After the operation is successful, the DNS servers are changed to Alibaba Cloud DNS servers. The names of these new servers end with hichina.com.

> **Prerequisite: This operation applies to domain names that are registered with Alibaba Cloud and currently use third-party DNS servers.**

example.unifiedCli: aliyun alidns modify-hichina-domain-dns --lang en --user-client-ip 192.0.2.0 --domain-name dns-example.top --region cn-hangzhou
